feature: Legacy BARP locked, paid first payment and current unpaid second payment

changes: Shared savedBappPreparationAllowed guard mirrors existing prepareBapp eligibility.
Actual next-step creation button in list/card and missing-BAPP route.
Saved amount passed from indexed list model; same exact term UUID and confirmed-state navigation.
Readonly core BARP stays locked; actual return/rejection required for changes; paid sibling preserved.
New requiresBarp gate, roles, scope, Head/settlement/money/private/ledger/approval rules unchanged.

performance.query_evidence: Existing pure legacy prepareBapp regression asserts zero DB queries; existing BAPP HTTP fixture36. No new server queries or query-per-row. Read model is client20DOM/loaded Map, not SQL pagination/load benchmark.

operational.data_rewrite: No bulk/GET backfill, financial status reset, fabricated BARP attestation or altered prior approval. Explicit prepareBapp retains established server audit/revision/receipt/source gates.
